title: Uniform bounds for a thermo-diffusive system beyond exponential growth
summary: In this paper, we prove a global-in-time uniform bound for solutions to a thermo-diffusive system in the whole space with bounded nonnegative initial data. The result allows exponential reaction rates and a range of superexponential rates determined by the diffusivities. This extends the recent results of La, Roquejoffre, and Ryzhik \cite{LRR24} and of Leontev and Ryzhik \cite{LR26} beyond their strictly subexponential range.
